deviations.why: The note suggested a paper step after 29 knob-turning sub-steps. Instead I took a real-data test the programme had named as its deciding open question (tank data for the wave term), using a newly found open source.
deviations.did: Validated strip theory and STAWAVE-2 against Kashiwagi 2022's measured slender-Wigley data, then rewrote the paper sentence around the result.
deviations.result: The tank data withdraw 7za's 2.90% best estimate and replace it with 3.7%. That is a paper-level change, not one more knob turn.

notes: Programme marine-hull, milestone 7zd. Read 64 measured added-resistance points and 41 motion points from the vector figures of Kashiwagi (2022, JSR 66(1), open copy at Osaka University) for a slender modified Wigley (L/B 6.67, B/T 2.4, Fn 0.2), a hull inside STAWAVE-2's range. Strip theory peaks at 11.42 against measured 9.23 to 13.17; STAWAVE-2 peaks at 5.42. STAWAVE-2's area agrees (0.94) only because its reflection term is 2.5 times the measurement in short waves. Tank-fitted zeta is 0.025, and the monohull 30 W loss is 3.69% (3.09% to 4.31%). Expectations: K2, K3, K6, K7 held; K1 refuted (heave); K4 and K5 split. Verification: marine-hull pytest 459 passed; check_numbers ok (140 claims); cite_check ok; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links and check_md_links ok; check_posts ok.
